name: Update all skills to latest
reach: open the Agent page > click "Agent actions" > click "Update all skills to latest…"
note: never confirm; the menu item needs write access to the agent

name: Skills
reach: open /customize/agents/new > fill Name=demo > fill Instructions=demo > click Continue
note: only where skill repositories are configured; without them Continue goes to Tools

name: Tools
reach: fill the Details step as for Skills > click Continue until the Tools step
note: a deep link without the Details fields goes back to Details

name: Review
reach: from the Tools step > click Continue

name: Connector
note: a tab shows only where the connector has something for it

name: Tool
reach: open the Kubernetes connector > click the first tool row
note: not a muster tool: those have no Usage tab

name: Resources
note: only when the connector has resources; pick one that has

name: Prompts
note: only when the connector has prompts; pick one that has

name: Instances
note: only for a connector family; open a family instead
